note: Two oracles for parse and check, from two repositories. The specification (pure-py-spec) holds the conformance suite and its runner, the `purepy-conformance` package; the suite is copied into test/conformance/ and committed, so the differential harness is hermetic. Since v0.23.1 the reference type checker and interpreter live in isabelle-purepy, generated from the Isabelle/HOL mechanisation; the generated code is not committed there, so the checker is taken from its release wheel, together with the `purepy-conformance` wheel it imports (which carries the figure-numbers.json the source tree lacks). The checker v0.27.9 is paired with spec v0.27.10, whose suite is byte-identical to v0.27.9's. The goldens under test/golden/ are generated from the wheel.
